# ARC Grid Task Solving

Use this for interactive ARC-style puzzle instances where the interface accepts demo requests and grid submissions.

## Workflow

1. **Parse the input exactly.** Record grid dimensions, background color, object colors, coordinates (state whether indexing is zero- or one-based), and repeated structures. Avoid relying on visually approximated row/column positions for large grids.
